issues_detected.recommendation: Document ethics review (or waiver), consent basis, deidentification method, reidentification risk, paediatric/neonatal protections and cohort demographics with inclusion/exclusion criteria.
issues_detected.description: Retrospective clinical data (EHR, notes, imaging, waveforms) on ICU/PICU/NICU patients from 14 hospitals, but no ethics review, consent or waiver, deidentification method, privacy risk or at-risk population documentation; demographics and inclusion criteria absent.

issues_detected.recommendation: Assign or record a dataset DOI and hosting repository, a formal citation and a release version.
issues_detected.description: No DOI, publisher, citation or version; id and page reuse the project website, which the record itself notes is under review for modification.

issues_detected.recommendation: Name the data use agreement and its key terms, add a confidentiality classification and applicable regulatory framework, and state prohibited/discouraged uses.
issues_detected.description: Licensing agreement is required but unnamed and its terms unstated; no confidentiality classification, regulatory compliance statement, prohibited/discouraged uses or impact analysis.

issues_detected.recommendation: Enumerate distributed files/formats with sizes and the enclave/platform access path for all users; give OMOP CDM version and vocabularies.
issues_detected.description: No distribution_formats, file enumeration or download/access platform; formats appear only as data standards without versions or schema references; access path is described only for training-program participants.

issues_detected.recommendation: Add tool versions/URLs, admission date ranges, contributing sites and a change history.
issues_detected.description: Processing tools lack versions/URLs; no collection timeframes, data collectors, raw data sources, version history or structured provenance.

issues_detected.recommendation: Document known biases (site selection, ICU population, missingness) and their effects on intended uses.
issues_detected.description: 'Equitable AI' and 'most diverse' claims are made without any known_biases or limitations documentation.

issues_detected.recommendation: Populate the missing core fields, especially variables for the OMOP tables.
issues_detected.description: Core fields doi, resources, parent_datasets, variables and confidentiality_level are absent (9/14 populated).

issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile counts to a dated release and state the size unit explicitly (TB vs Tb).
issues_detected.description: Admission counts (50,000 on website vs over 45K in webinar) and imaging counts (1000 images vs 7,642 admissions) differ; the record explicitly retains and explains both. The '23 Tb' size unit is ambiguous.

issues_detected.recommendation: Confirm the contact email domain with the project.
issues_detected.description: Contact email domain 'mgh.havard.edu' appears misspelled (likely 'harvard'); the record flags it as reproduced from source.

semantic_insights: Record is careful about provenance of claims: future-tense grant statements, count discrepancies and the GitHub MIT license are explicitly caveated rather than overstated.
Largest gaps are human-subjects protections, persistent identification/versioning and bias documentation for a multi-site clinical dataset with paediatric and neonatal patients.
Access is documented as controlled with registration and a signed agreement, but only for the training-program route.
